_how: Kris edits this. One entry per fixable chat-engine error: a name, a pattern (a regex searched in the engine's error text, whitespace collapsed and lowercased), a fixer (a function in crew/runners/chat_repair.py) and a _why. The window runs the first entry whose pattern matches, once per failed message, never on a good one. An entry that matches but changes nothing is reported as no-match, so a wrong pattern can never break a chat.

repairs.name: bmp-mime
repairs._why: OpenCode labels a .bmp screenshot image/x-ms-bmp; Synthetic refuses that label, so the model call answers 400 and the same 400 comes back on every later message of that chat. The stored part is rewritten to image/bmp (the mime field and the data: URL prefix), then the window sends the message again.

repairs.name: bmp-mime-raw
repairs._why: The same fix for a caller that only has the provider's raw response body (which names the type but not the sentence above). It comes second so the full sentence wins when both match; it can only ever rewrite this one type.
